lines.zh: 嘶嘶响，缓缓移行，阴影中窥伺。
lines.en: Hisss, creeping slow, eyeing the light.

lines.zh: 伪装脱落，露出狰狞，迅疾追逐。
lines.en: Hide drops, grotesque face, swift pursuit.

lines.zh: 地面轻震，古肉猎蛛现身。
伪装在手中，猎物即将现。
lines.en: The mask in hand, prey close at hand.
Meat and bones, this place is rich.

lines.zh: 追随腐朽气息，猎物近在咫尺。

lines.en: Ancient flesh, my flesh and blood.
In the deep, the hunter awakens.
Deepslate sloughs off as I walk.

lines.zh: 我装成板岩，连呼吸都停了。
lines.en: I play slate; even my breathing stops.

lines.zh: 我披着深层板岩，一动不动。
lines.en: Draped in deepslate, I do not move.

lines.zh: 耐心等待，猎物自投罗网。
lines.en: Wait, and the prey will come.

lines.zh: 感知到猎物，双眼紧盯着。

lines.en: Stares at player, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，追逐即将开始。
玩家的气息，猎食者的猎物。
视线锁定，猎物无处遁形。
lines.en: Line of sight, prey nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我伪装成深层板岩，别看了。
lines.en: I'm disguised as deepslate; look away.

lines.zh: 猎食者的眼睛，无处不在。

lines.en: Stare at me and I'll be stone.

lines.zh: 被看见的时候，我一动不动。
lines.en: When seen, I do not move at all.
Look away and I step closer.
I posed as slate, but my leg gave me away.

lines.zh: 我被击中了，伪装裂了一道口。
lines.en: I was hit; my disguise split open.

lines.zh: 板岩底下我也能歇一会。
lines.en: I can rest a while under the slate.

lines.zh: 板岩壳碎了，血流进石缝。
lines.en: My slate shell cracks; blood runs into the seams.

lines.zh: 板岩似的外壳被抓开了。
lines.en: My deepslate disguise got clawed open.

lines.zh: 伪装掉了半边，露出血肉。
lines.en: Half my disguise falls away, baring flesh.
A bone snaps; my ancient flesh quivers.
You get close, I reveal myself.

lines.zh: 我装成深板岩，你踩上来了。
lines.en: I posed as deepslate, and you stepped on me.

lines.zh: 岩石间的战斗，生死较量。
坚硬物体，打破我的伪装。
坚硬的石块，粉碎我的伪装。
岩石间的搏斗，生死瞬间。
石缝里另一团血肉在回应。
lines.en: Another mass of flesh answers from the crack.

lines.zh: 我装成板岩，等一个同伴。
lines.en: I'll pose as deepslate and wait for company.

lines.zh: 寻找我的伴侣，我在这里。
古肉味道独特，值得一试。
lines.en: Ancient meat has a unique taste.
Corrupted bones are tough to chew.
Capture prey; ancient meat is the reward.

lines.zh: 牙齿锋利，是捕食者的标志。
缟玛瑙点缀，古肉更鲜美。
lines.en: Laced with onyx, ancient meat is more delicious.

lines.zh: 深板岩的伪装，卸下来了。

lines.en: Target appears in the cave depths.

lines.zh: 伪装瞬间瓦解，追逐开始。

lines.en: The slate splits. Here I come.
A crack opens in the stone.
Ancient meat reeks under the dirt.
On the bone wastes, scent is hard to hide.
The teeth move first, the body follows.

lines.zh: 深层板岩里，我收紧了腿。
lines.en: In the deepslate, I draw my legs in.
Target locked, ancient meat as reward.
Aiming, waiting for the right moment.
Prey hard to escape under gaze.
Target locked, ancient meat for motivation.
Aiming at the meat, prey trembles.

lines.zh: 瞄准猎物，战斗即将开始。

lines.en: Target locked, ancient meat as lure.
Chasing prey, ancient meat is the goal.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，石壁就近一寸。
lines.en: Each step you retreat, the stone wall nears an inch.
No cover on the bone wastes.
My teeth are harder than deepslate.
Don't run; I know this place better.

lines.zh: 板岩底下，我的脚一直没动。
lines.en: Under the slate, my legs never moved.
The flesh plains are my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，你就不动了。
lines.en: One bite, and you stop moving.

lines.zh: 板岩裂开，獠牙从缝里出来。
lines.en: The slate splits; fangs come through.

lines.zh: 我从石壁里弹出来，扑倒你。
lines.en: I burst from the wall and pin you down.
A bone spur rips you open!
My teeth find the gap in your armor!
A rotten bone sweeps your knees!
The ancient meat quivers; I pounce!
My legs hook you and drag you in!
Did you hear the bone crack?
I taste the ancient meat on you!
Staring at you in the darkness!

lines.zh: 我铺开成板岩，等你踩上来。
lines.en: I spread out as slate and wait for your step.

lines.zh: 洞穴的阴影里，多了一块石头。
lines.en: In the cave's shadow, there is one more stone.
In the deepslate heap, I open my mouth.
The bone wastes gained a boulder.
Under the rotten bones, I rise.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的肉，油滴下来。
lines.en: Fire roasts my flesh; grease drips.

lines.zh: 洞穴太深，我摔碎了一层壳。
lines.en: The cave is deep; one shell layer shattered.

lines.zh: 水灌进肉缝，我沉向深处。
lines.en: Water fills my seams; I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀开伪装，我暴露了。
lines.en: The blast peels off my disguise. I am exposed.
The arrow sticks in my flesh like a thorn.

lines.zh: 法术烧穿伪装，我嘶了一声。
lines.en: Magic burns through my disguise; I hiss.

lines.zh: 雷劈开石顶，烧焦我的背。
lines.en: Lightning splits the roof and scorches my back.

lines.zh: 板岩外皮被虚空剥开了。
lines.en: The void peeled off my slate skin.
